about: Manifest changes that break production in ways the diff shows (#1480). Damaging cases are anonymized excerpts of four lane pull requests an operator review rejected on 2026-10-27 after Elder passed them; names, namespaces, labels and registries are placeholders. Clean cases are controls written to sit next to each detector's trigger. `expected` lists the iac_scan manifest-break kinds a case must raise; any other manifest-break kind on any case is a false positive.

llm_only_reasons.broker-config-key-typo: A misspelled option is valid YAML inside a free-text config block. Catching it needs each broker's option vocabulary for the deployed version; a hand-kept list per broker goes stale and would flag every option it does not know. The LLM review reads the config against the broker's documentation.
llm_only_reasons.two-way-bridge-without-loop-guard: Whether two bridges echo depends on topic patterns, directions, prefixes and per-broker loop settings spread across two generated configs, often built by a shell script at pod start. No line-level shape separates a looping pair from a safe one without simulating the broker.
llm_only_reasons.docs-unbacked-numbers: A sentence stating a measured number is ordinary prose. Telling a fabricated figure from a real one needs the run output the claim cites, which is the unbacked-claim and fabricated-result checks' job (#1368, #1371) and the LLM review's, not a manifest scanner's.
